text: Before tuning anything, this lesson times the first lap -- a real performance baseline for PolicyClaimsDB.
Query Store gets tuned for a transactional workload, then PolicyClaimsDB runs through a full day of real claims-processing traffic before anything is captured as a baseline.
AUTO capture mode skips one-off ad hoc queries and keeps storage focused on the queries the app actually repeats, exactly what a baseline needs.
The top twenty queries by duration, CPU, and logical I/O get pulled and frozen into a dated table, the number every future tuning claim gets measured against.
The baseline is captured. Next up: troubleshooting and validation, where real-world gaps in this build start to surface.
